newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka forex market closed for public holiday.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka forex market closed for public holiday.

text.p: Sri Lanka's foreign exchange market was closed on Tuesday for the Independence Day holiday.
On Monday, the rupee closed weaker, at 57.70 to the dollar after opening at 57.64, pressured by late commercial demand for the greenback.
Overnight call money closed at 13.5 percent on Monday, after opening at 14 percent and rising early to 14.5 percent, as banks sourced two days of money due to the public holiday.
The foreign exchange market will reopen on Wednesday.
